paper_title: Rethinking the Role of Prompting Strategies in LLM Test-Time Scaling A   Perspective of Probability Theory
caption: Results of combining adaptively scaling and dynamically choosing the optimal i on Qwen2.5-7B-Instruct on MATH.

model_annotations.Bulgarian:
The graph illustrates the relationship between sampling time and accuracy for various prompting strategies, showing how they change over time. 

The X-axis is labeled "Sampling Time", has a linear scale, and ranges from 0 to 70. The axis is marked at intervals of 10 units, starting from 0 and ending at 70. The Y-axis is labeled "Accuracy", also has a linear scale, and spans from 60 to 88. It is marked at intervals of 4 units, beginning at 60 and concluding at 88.

The graph includes seven distinct lines representing different prompting strategies: DiP (purple, solid line with triangles), AnP (orange, solid line with circles), CoT (light blue, solid line with triangles), Dynamic w/ Oracle (black, dashed line with squares), L2M (dark blue, solid line with triangles), Adaptive + Dynamic w/ Oracle (red, dashed line with circles), and SBP (peach, solid line with triangles). 

The DiP line starts at around 60 on the Y-axis at a sampling time of 0 and increases sharply to approximately 72 at a sampling time of 10. It continues to rise gradually, reaching about 78 at a sampling time of 30, before leveling off at around 78-79 for the remainder of the sampling time. The AnP line begins at roughly 64 on the Y-axis at a sampling time of 0, jumps to approximately 76 at a sampling time of 10, and then gradually rises to about 74 at a sampling time of 70. The CoT line commences at around 60 on the Y-axis at a sampling time of 0, surges to approximately 68 at a sampling time of 10, and continues to ascend, eventually stabilizing at around 78 from a sampling time of 40 onwards. The Dynamic w/ Oracle line remains relatively constant throughout, starting at around 84 at a sampling time of 0 and ending at approximately 85 at a sampling time of 70. The L2M line initiates at roughly 60 on the Y-axis at a sampling time of 0, leaps to approximately 66 at a sampling time of 10, and then continues to climb, ultimately plateauing at around 78 from a sampling time of 40 onwards. The Adaptive + Dynamic w/ Oracle line starts at approximately 86 on the Y-axis at a sampling time of 0 and gradually increases to around 89 at a sampling time of 70. The SBP line begins at roughly 72 on the Y-axis at a sampling time of 0, rises to approximately 75 at a sampling time of 10, and then continues to ascend gradually, eventually stabilizing at around 77 from a sampling time of 20 onwards.
